description: Wrong or shallow technical answers, buzzwords without reasoning.

messages.text: How would you make a payment API idempotent?
I would make it idempotent by using a POST request and checking if the payment is successful, and if it fails we retry it a few times automatically.
A query on transactions by merchant and date is slow. What do you do?
I'd add indexes on all the columns so every query is fast, and maybe move to MongoDB because it's faster for big data.
I'd put Redis in front of everything including balances, that way the database doesn't get any load and it's very fast.
The bank's API times out during a payout. What happens?
We show the user payment failed and they can try again, and our code retries the payout too so it eventually goes through.
Thanks, that's all from me. The team will be in touch.
